title: The Deadly Booby Traps Inside Emperor Qin's Tomb

scenes.name: The Unopened Pyramid Mound
scenes.narration: Archaeologists excavated the Terracotta Army decades ago, but they still refuse to open Emperor Qin's central burial mound.

scenes.name: Tripwire Bronze Crossbows
scenes.narration: Ancient texts reveal the sealed corridors are rigged with mechanical repeating crossbows designed to shoot anyone who steps on hidden floor plates.

scenes.name: Rivers of Liquid Mercury
scenes.narration: Even more terrifying, automated pumps circulate one hundred tons of pure liquid mercury to mimic the great rivers of China.

scenes.name: Lethal Toxic Vapor Accumulation
scenes.narration: Over two thousand years, this has filled the sealed vault with dense toxic vapors capable of causing rapid brain failure within breaths.

scenes.name: Cosmic Ray Scanning
scenes.narration: To explore the tomb safely without triggering traps or inhaling poison, scientists now use cosmic ray scanners to map the interior from above.
